create_buckets_create: create a new HuggingFace Hub bucket with an optional private flag and quiet output
test_buckets_create: test the hf buckets create command with private, exist-ok, and hf:// prefix options
list_buckets_list: list HuggingFace Hub buckets in table, JSON, or quiet format with optional namespace and search
test_buckets_list: test the hf buckets list command with tree view, recursive, human-readable, and quiet modes
rm_buckets_rm: remove files from a HuggingFace Hub bucket with recursive, include, exclude, and dry-run options
test_buckets_rm: test the hf buckets rm command for single file, recursive, dry-run, and include/exclude filtering
cp_buckets_cp: copy files between local filesystem and HuggingFace Hub buckets with upload, download, and stdin support
test_buckets_cp: test the hf buckets cp command for local-to-bucket, bucket-to-local, bucket-to-bucket, and error validation
sync_buckets_sync: sync files bidirectionally between local directories and HuggingFace Hub buckets with delete, plan, and filter options
test_buckets_sync: test the hf buckets sync command for upload, download, delete, plan/apply, dry-run, and filtering workflows
